extra.axes_note: TWO INDEPENDENT AXES, only one of which the level name states. `_ss` = the far-field clamp h_far=min(2.5,120*h_wall) is OFF (self-similar) and says NOTHING about the tip. `_flat` = flat tip cap; ABSENCE of `_flat` = ROUND, but only since 2026-08-04 -- before that date the same name meant FLAT, and that silent flip is the 2.0 % that stood five days (phase 3 round 36, F-MESH). h_far_over_h_wall == 120 means the clamp did not bite, i.e. this level IS on the refinement ray.
